releaseNotes: Emergency stabilization after 0.12.16: normal BOOX text input and caret interaction are restored
All stacked Notes hotfix scripts 0.12.8 through 0.12.16 are removed from the delivered index so their old listeners can no longer compete
Exactly one large 52px BOOX-safe resize handle remains; legacy and rich-text handles are suppressed
The rich-text overlay introduced in 0.12.16 is removed because it blocked writing on the real BOOX device
Text block width and height are saved on input, resize, blur and before tool switches, then restored from canonical note geometry
Automatic growth expands to the right while space remains and then downward when wrapping is needed
The stable text options row and delete confirmation remain available
Per-character mixed text colors are temporarily deferred until the core editor is hardware-stable; this release prioritizes reliable writing and geometry
No new APK is required; Shell 1.1.0 remains sufficient
